WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        event_status,
        AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_diff
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY event_status
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS baseline_value
    FROM status_averages
)
SELECT 
    s.event_status AS status,
    s.avg_diff AS average,
    s.avg_diff - b.baseline_value AS average_minus_baseline
FROM status_averages s
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE b.baseline_value IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: A missing difference is represented as NULL in the database, which occurs when either 'amount' or 'spent' is NULL (standard SQL behavior where arithmetic involving NULL yields NULL).
